title: Javelin

sources.title: Piercing Strike
markers: | description = Stab an enemy and possibly inflict {{cond|Gaping Wounds}}.

summary: Simple one-handed javelin dealing 1d6 Piercing. Can be thrown.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d6 Piercing plus Strength modifier. 5 ft melee. Simple, one-handed, thrown and dippable. Throw range depends on the thrower and target location.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. On a weapon hit, Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are unaffected. In standard modes, affected targets take 2 extra Piercing damage when hit. In Honour Mode, any damage source deals 2 extra damage of its original type.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
